method: Single independent council reviewer using Impeccable Operate/Read principles and the requested ky-suite-v2 council method; this is not a claim to the separate full dual-assessment /impeccable critique workflow. No child agents or overlay server were started.

rubric.rounding: Decimal exact weighted sum, ROUND_HALF_UP to one decimal; cohort means over unique rounded per-file totals, also half-up.
rubric.blind_order: The 12 unique CURRENT original-resolution images were inspected and all six integer score vectors fixed before reading either prior numeric report. Four workspace near duplicates were verified by hashes/pixel diffs and visually spot-checked later; they inherit scores. Stage 02 was never treated as current.
rubric.ky_fit: Separate equal mean of four dimensions; suite_cohesion N/A because no second product captured set was inspected.

verdict.score_basis: notes cohort mean across 8 unique CURRENT views; settings reported separately and not blended
verdict.scope: 8/10 visual progression for existing Notes reading/navigation/settings plus scoped shared status/field changes
verdict.reason: Notes reaches 8.1 and Settings 8.4. The zero-row picker, dirty-state reset and scoped field-boundary objections have concrete current fixes/evidence; no remaining in-scope P1 blocker was found. The picker subview is still 7.8 and full 9/10 behavior acceptance is not established.
verdict.what_reaches_8: This product cohort reaches 8 now. To bring the remaining 7.8 picker surface itself above 8, reduce its existing preamble while keeping recovery information available and page targets initially visible.
full_acceptance_blockers: Complete product keyboard and focus coverage
All product contrast roles in all shipped themes
Final implementation verification remains owned by the implementation thread; fresh full Go/browser completion was not asserted here.
